title: excellent quality
text: excellent quality. This laundry basket was a bit more than others but worth every penny.  I would have awarded 5 stars had it come with instructions! Having said that - I figured it out in about an hour.  I had help from my niece.  She recommended taping the allen wrench and such that came with it for future use if it needs to be disassembled which I did.
